extension.description: Add any number of Stremio addon manifests and browse their catalogs, metadata, streams and subtitles from inside Kodi.
extension.disclaimer: This add-on provides no content. You are responsible for the Stremio addons you install and the content they provide.
extension.news: v0.14.1 - Kodi profiles: each profile's home widgets are its own, and switching profile no longer loads the home screen twice or holds up the next profile's services. With Arctic Zephyr Stremio, menus are handed over by the skin (nothing polls in the background). New setting Search > Search Cinemeta too. v0.14.0 - Faster information pages, most of all for long-running shows (read a season at a time). Play starts the next episode to watch and the episodes open on it; resuming asks once, not twice; selecting a title opens its page sooner; widgets load faster. New splash. v0.13.3 - With Arctic Zephyr Stremio, Kodi's own splash at start-up can be the Kodi Stremio Bridge splash (skin setting, on by default). v0.13.2 - New Playback setting "When a title is selected": show its information page (default) or play it. Seasons follow it too. v0.13.1 - Setup in three steps: MDBList API key (Skip, Enter, Cancel setup), a Stremio addon (Enter, Cancel setup), then more addons until Skip.
